title: tilia croizatii
intro: Tilia croizatii, commonly known as the Chinese linden or small leaved lime, is a deciduous tree native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and stress, promoting sleep, and relieving anxiety and hypertension. The therapeutic actions of Tilia croizatii include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tilia croizatii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
